quests.title: The Dead Patch at Chinatown
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. The number three green at Chinatown has had a bald patch the shape of Tasmania since a Tuesday, and the committee thinks I am inventing it. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: the patch, with something in frame for scale
bring it to me before the meeting

quests.title: Turf Money, Chinatown
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. They have seen the photograph and now they want it re-laid by a Tuesday, which means finding $57 that the Chinatown club does not have. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: $57, however you like, I am not asking
put it in my hand, not the safe

quests.title: The Chinatown Membership Count
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. Our books say 85 members at Chinatown and I would bet the bar takings that half of them are dead or moved to Queensland. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: stand at the side door where the list is kept
the board with the names still on it
read me the ones you did not recognise

quests.title: Closing Time Rumour, Chinatown
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Since five in the morning somebody has been going round the Chinatown greens telling the barefoot bowlers we are shutting, and we are not shutting. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: whoever is doing the telling
and take the bar money off them while you are there

quests.title: Behind the Bar at Chinatown
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. There is a roll of raffle tickets in the chest freezer behind the bar at Chinatown and I am not opening it on an empty stomach. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: get one into you first, seriously
round the back where the cellar door is
whatever is in there, before I lose my nerve

quests.title: The Old Greenkeeper, Chinatown
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. The man who kept these greens before me drinks at Convention now, and he owes Chinatown an explanation about the drainage. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: find him and hear him out
come back and tell me what he said

quests.title: Nights at Chatswood
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Every night around two in the afternoon the same car does three laps of the Chatswood forecourt and never buys fuel. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: the car, plate if you can get it
I want it on record before I ring anyone

quests.title: The Third Lap, Chatswood
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Now I know the plate, I want to know where it goes after it leaves Chatswood at two in the afternoon, because it is not going home. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: follow it as far as Artarmon
wherever it stops

quests.title: Bay Two, Chatswood
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. Bay two at the Chatswood workshop has had the same car in it since a wet Monday and the owner has stopped answering. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the address on the job card
the letterbox, so I know I have the right house
tell me if anybody actually lives there

quests.title: Tools Off the Bench, Chatswood
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Someone has been walking out of Chatswood with a socket set at a time since a wet Monday, and I have run out of ways to be polite about it. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: the ones hanging round the air hose
$59 of it back, that is what the set cost

quests.title: The Chatswood Price Board
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. Head office says the Chatswood board has been wrong since a wet Monday and I say it has been right for eleven years, and one of us is about to be embarrassed. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: buy something so it is a real transaction
the board and the pump, both in the one shot
that settles it either way

quests.title: The Other Franchise, Chatswood
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. The bloke who runs the site at Roseville has had the same trouble Chatswood has, and he will talk to you before he talks to me. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: find him on shift
whatever he says, I want it word for word

quests.title: Level Two, Waterloo
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Water has been coming through the level two ceiling of the Waterloo block since a wet Monday and the strata report says there is no water. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: the ceiling, with the stain visible
that goes in the file whether they like it or not

quests.title: The Special Levy, Waterloo
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. The photo did it. I have rung the number on the letter four times. Now every owner at Waterloo owes $76 and I have to collect it from people who have avoided me for a year. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: $76 out of them, in any state
I will not ask how

quests.title: Car Space 14, Waterloo
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. Somebody who does not live at Waterloo has parked in space fourteen every night since a wet Monday and the manager will not look at it. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: down to the basement, the far corner
the car in the space with the number painted beside it

quests.title: The Meeting, Waterloo
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. The Waterloo AGM is on a wet Monday and I would like to arrive with something stronger than a grievance and a printout. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: two coffees, one is for me
the community room where they hold it
walk in with me, they behave when there is a witness

quests.title: Bin Night at Waterloo
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. Three units at Waterloo have put their bins out on the wrong night since a wet Monday and I have taken it personally, which I accept is a choice I made. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: the ones who argue about it
the fine the council gave me, off them

quests.title: The Other Block, Waterloo
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. There is a block at Erskineville with the same builder and the same cracks, and their manager has already been through what Waterloo is starting. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: go and ask them how it ended
I need to know how much worse this gets
